purpose: measure existing A row-space and B column-space coverage of legal selected reference operators

definitions.generated_A_captured: same using each saved generated A; complementary residual is best possible error if only B could change
definitions.generated_B_captured: mean36 ||P_col(B_gen) E||_F^2 / D_l; complementary residual is best possible error if only A could change
definitions.initial_B_gradient: at B=0, dL/dB is proportional to -E A0^T; dL/dA is exactly zero
definitions.limitations: label-side algebra only, no new task inputs, fitted controller, deployment or causal intervention; no control claim
